answer: Past the saffron, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Vouching with teeth: admission requires a sponsor who stakes funds on the newcomer's honesty, forfeiting the stake on conviction. Under the relic, a farm cannot self-vouch — it must buy the trust of real, established agents, and each fake it smuggles in puts a sponsor's bond on the line. Hold the inlet steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
